Format a progress summary as an interactive table

Source: R/app.R
tb_status_table.Rd

Turns the output of tb_progress_summary() into a DT::datatable() with readable column names and colour-coded status labels (the status is always also written as text, so colour is never the only signal).

Usage

tb_status_table(summary)

Arguments

summary

A data frame returned by tb_progress_summary().

Value

A DT::datatable() widget.

Examples

s <- tb_progress_summary(indicator = "incidence",
                         countries = c("Kenya", "India", "Brazil"))
tb_status_table(s)
